finalText:
Handoff is written to `incident-handoff.md`.

Short version: 503s started at 2:14 AM and are still happening as of the last log line at 3:59 AM. Root cause is `dep-4471`, a gateway config deploy that turned on `gateway.pool.perRequest`, which exhausted the 20-connection pool within 33 seconds. Only the gateway was hit, workers stayed healthy throughout. Roll back `dep-4471`.
